s-1.ptxt: Remove Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3 (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Detach the clamp and disconnect the parking brake cable support clamp sub-assembly.
Disconnect parking brake cable assembly No.3 from the disc brake cylinder assembly RR LH.
Using an offset wrench (14mm), remove parking brake cable assembly No.3 from the disc brake cylinder assembly RR LH.

atten4.ptxt: Insert the offset wrench all the way into the clip as shown in the illustration, flex the clip, and pull parking brake cable assembly No.3 out of the guide of the disc brake cylinder assembly RR LH.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 bolts and parking brake cable assembly No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3 (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect parking brake cable assembly No.3 from the disc brake cylinder assembly RR LH.
Using an offset wrench (14mm), remove parking brake cable assembly No.3 from the disc brake cylinder assembly RR LH.

atten4.ptxt: Insert the offset wrench all the way into the clip as shown in the illustration, flex the clip, and pull parking brake cable assembly No.3 out of the guide of the disc brake cylinder assembly RR LH.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 bolts and parking brake cable assembly No.3.

atten4.ptxt: The bolt positions of parking brake cable assembly No.2 are symmetrical to those of parking brake cable assembly No.3, except for part [A].
